transitions.guard: NOT SensorFaultCalc AND NOT Inhibit_s AND NOT HighWet_s AND NOT LowWet_s
NOT SensorFaultCalc AND NOT Inhibit_s AND NOT HighWet_s AND LowWet_s
NOT SensorFaultCalc AND NOT Inhibit_s AND NOT HighWet_s

priorities: Sensor inconsistency or Inhibit forces OFF on the current scan.
HighWet forces OFF on the current scan.
If not stopped and LowWet is false, enter FILLING.
Otherwise retain the previous state in the middle band.
SensorFault is not latched; it clears immediately when the contradictory input combination clears.

initial_values.note: These are pre-invocation values. The first scan executes normally and may set Fill true.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.actions: Sample LowWet, HighWet and Inhibit once into their _s variables. No edge detection is required.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.actions: Calculate SensorFaultCalc := HighWet_s AND NOT LowWet_s. Apply the prioritized transition from the retained state using the sampled inputs. Instance initialization resets state to OFF; there is no reset input.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.actions: No timer FBs are required, so this stage contains no calls.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.actions: Assign Fill := (state = FILLING) and SensorFault := SensorFaultCalc. Both reflect the current scan.
